{{Quote|I love ''The Lifeday Murders''. I have a copy on my datapad.|Mulus Cheems|<ref name="Mercy Kill" />}}
'''''The Lifeday Murders''''' was a piece of media that starred [[Youngling/Legends|child]] [[Actor/Legends|actor]] [[Garik Loran]] and was released by [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]]. [[Scientist/Legends|Scientist]] [[Mulus Cheems]] was a fan of ''The Lifeday Murders'' in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]] and had a copy on his [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]].<ref name="Mercy Kill" /> It shared its name with the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] holiday of [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|253|Life Day}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
''The Lifeday Murders'' was mentioned in the [[2012]] novel ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'', written by [[Aaron Allston]] as the last book in the [[Star Wars: X-Wing (novel series)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']] series of novels.<ref name="Mercy Kill" />
